pre_registered_rule: promote if val IG > +0.02 AND test IG > 0 (source_ig_test aug-vs-base, Poisson HGB on count35)

data.frame: global IGS20 (NGL retired IGS14; the per-station secular fit absorbs the reference-frame plate velocity)
data.availability_caveat: most Marmara cGPS stations stopped reporting to NGL after ~2023-2024, so the latest test windows (2025-2026) are GNSS-sparse (features null there).

availability_vs_time.verdict: REJECTED — the pure availability flag has NEGATIVE test IG and active/inactive y35 rates are similar, so availability-vs-time is not driving the gain. The availability flag (gnss_strain_fallback) is EXCLUDED from the model.

spatial_support_placebo.method: permute each cell's GNSS values across windows (preserve spatial support + marginal, destroy time-alignment)
spatial_support_placebo.verdict: majority genuine — val collapses ~90%, test ~62% under the placebo; a residual spatial-support component (~+0.037 test) remains, but the deconfounded signal (val +0.022, test +0.061) is real time-varying deformation.

within_active_period_ig.note: within the GNSS-active period the physical features add strong information (+0.186), independent of the active-vs-dead split.

decision_basis: both the raw IG (val 0.0245>0.02, test 0.0977>0) AND the deconfounded IG (val 0.0220>0.02, test 0.0609>0) satisfy the pre-registered rule; the availability confound is rejected and the placebo confirms a genuine time-varying component.
promotion: added as `hybrid_gnss` = the hybrid ML with the four PHYSICAL gnss_v2 columns appended (availability flag excluded). grid.FEATURES (catalog features, leakage-tested) left UNCHANGED so test_grid_leakage stays intact; GNSS causality is covered bit-for-bit by test_sources_truncated. `hybrid` (no GNSS) is kept alongside so the bootstrap can put a CI on the +GNSS delta.

operational_effect_y35_test.conclusion: Promoting GNSS into the operational hybrid does NOT improve it: hybrid vs hybrid_gnss is INSEPARABLE (the IG CI marginally favours the NON-GNSS hybrid; PR-AUC straddles 0). So the genuine source-level GNSS information (deconfounded +0.061 test IG on the count-model) is LARGELY REDUNDANT with the seismicity/cascade signal in the full forecaster. The pre-registered rule promoted GNSS on its source-IG; the bootstrap honestly shows the operational skill gain is not statistically resolvable. This is the headline Phase-2 result: a real, adversarially-verified GNSS signal that nonetheless does not move the operational forecaster.
